title: Planning Definition Editor Roadmap
goal: Make Harbor One Planning the authoritative editor and reader for versioned project and roadmap definitions while excluding every mutable execution concern from the Planning payload and screen.

skills.purpose: parent orchestrator, dependency and claim authority

model.reason: the current execution surface did not expose a separate worker-model selection for root

frozen_decision.planning_is: The versioned definition plane for projects, roadmap revisions, DAG structure, requirements, gate definitions and completion contracts.
frozen_decision.planning_is_not: A monitor, dashboard, control plane or persistence location for a running agent execution.
frozen_decision.agent_is: The only Harbor One screen that renders mutable execution state and accepts run controls.
frozen_decision.entrypoint_rule: Planning may prepare an exact /abc command in the Agent composer, but Planning must not call a run-start endpoint, submit the composer or choose skills or models.
frozen_decision.pinning_rule: Every Agent run consumes one immutable approved Planning revision and content hash. A later Planning revision never changes an existing run.
frozen_decision.projection_rule: PlanningDefinitionProjector is a pure function of one Planning revision. It must not read Agent state, Temporal state, localStorage, chat text or a latest mutable roadmap after the requested revision is resolved.

visible: roadmap title, objective, assumptions, constraints and scope
approved revision, content hash and revision lifecycle
work, gate, milestone and group node definitions
deliverables, allowed paths and blocked paths
capability requirements without concrete skill or model selections
gate definitions, decision requirements and safe defaults without decisions
draft diff, validation errors, conflicts, accept, discard, tombstone, restore and undo
Open in Agent handoff for one exact approved revision
forbidden: run existence or current run status
Temporal workflow id or workflow run id
activities, attempts, retries, timers or history
heartbeat time, age, health or stale state
claims, leases, fencing tokens, workers or hotfile collisions
Signals, Updates, command receipts or allowed run commands
runtime gate decisions, approvers or decision timestamps
execution evidence receipts, changed files, commits, pushes, merges or deploys
pause, resume, cancel, terminate, retry, steer or decide-gate controls
selected skills, models or route history
progress bars or node colors derived from execution

graph_semantics.node_color_source: node kind or definition validation state only
graph_semantics.gate_node_semantics: A gate node describes a requirement and safe default. It never shows pending, approved, rejected, expired or waived runtime state.
graph_semantics.completeness_metric: definition_completeness_percent may count populated required definition fields. It must not count completed work or passed runtime gates.

planning_ui_behavior: Resolve and validate the exact approved revision before navigation.
Populate, but do not submit, the Agent composer with the exact /abc command.
Attach the handoff envelope as read-only composer context.
Do not call POST /api/agent/runs and do not choose skills or models.
agent_handoff_contract.conflict_rule: If revision or hash no longer matches, stay in Planning and render conflict. Never substitute latest_approved implicitly.

planning_api_contract.write_authority_rule: Accept remains blocked by the exact Planning apply authority. Discard is owner-scoped and idempotent. No Planning endpoint starts or controls a run.
prohibited_endpoints: any Planning history or heartbeat stream
any Planning pause, resume, cancel, retry, steer or gate-decision endpoint

legacy_projection.input: odysseus.planning.roadmap v1 and harbor.planning.roadmap legacy alias
legacy_projection.rule: Legacy files remain read-only compatibility input. A structural projector emits definition v2 and recursively drops runtime fields and runtime-like status values.
legacy_projection.write_rule: No v2 writer may re-emit a dropped legacy execution field.
legacy_projection.migration_rule: No mass rewrite is required. A roadmap becomes v2 canonical only through an explicit validated revision apply.
planning_mcp_changes_required: Deprecate planning_mark_status for canonical v2 definitions.
Replace live gate status output with gate-definition reads on Planning surfaces.
Remove progress, todo-completion and agent-checkpoint semantics from the canonical definition projection.
storage_contract_changes_required: Replace roadmap running, blocked and done definition states with the revision lifecycle vocabulary.
Replace open, go and no_go gate records with odysseus.planning.gate_definition requirements.
Move runtime gate instances, progress, attempts, heartbeats, claims and evidence receipts outside the Planning root.

slice_queue.objective: Freeze one definition-only Planning contract, one Agent handoff envelope and one recursive runtime-field denylist.
deliverables: screen ownership MUST and MUST NOT rules
local DAG and cross-roadmap dependency declarations
evidence_required: valid JSON
all child references resolve
obsolete V2 execution semantics are marked superseded in the master

gate.safe_default: Roadmap authoring only; do not implement code or UI in this slice.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if the master and this child unambiguously assign definition truth to Planning, execution truth to Agent and /abc as the only run entrypoint.
stop_rules: Stop on a runtime field remaining allowed in Planning.
Stop on a shared master edit without current ownership.

slice_queue.objective: Implement the definition v2 schema and fail-closed validator without routes, persistence or UI.
deliverables: exact project, roadmap, node, edge, gate-definition and done-contract schemas
unique ID, missing reference, cycle, gate target and completion reference checks
approved revision immutability and deterministic content hash validation
evidence_required: positive canonical fixture
one negative fixture for every forbidden state and reference failure
hash determinism across key order

completion_evidence.schema_result: Draft 2020-12 meta-schema check and canonical fixture validation passed
invariants: all recursive runtime keys and forbidden execution states are rejected
all declared reference, cycle, gate-target and completion failures have stable reason codes
approved revisions are checked against an immutable hash baseline
validator is standard-library-only and imports no Agent or Temporal module

gate.safe_default: Pure validation only; no file write outside test temporary directories.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if every canonical fixture validates and every runtime field, execution state, cycle, missing reference, invalid gate target or changed approved hash is rejected with a stable reason code.
stop_rules: Stop if validation requires live Planning writes.
Stop if the implementation imports Agent or Temporal modules.

slice_queue.objective: Expose one definition-only read model for project list, roadmap list, graph, document and revision history.
deliverables: legacy v1 structural projection with dropped runtime fields
the five read endpoints declared in planning_api_contract
loading, live, stale, unavailable and error origin metadata
evidence_required: same revision produces byte-stable normalized payload
no Agent or Temporal provider is called
pagination never returns raw private content

gate.safe_default: Implement service and route tests first; register app.py only under a serial hotfile claim.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if one service payload drives all Planning readers, contains no denylisted key recursively and returns the requested revision rather than an implicit mutable latest value.
stop_rules: Stop on dirty overlapping app.py hunks.
Stop if a read endpoint exposes a run, heartbeat, claim, evidence receipt or command.

slice_queue.objective: Implement draft creation, validation, conflict detection, accepted revision apply, tombstone, restore and undo with optimistic concurrency.
deliverables: the three write endpoints declared in planning_api_contract
base revision, base hash, expected draft version and idempotency checks
undo metadata and immutable accepted revision
evidence_required: temporary-repository apply and restore
concurrent draft conflict
duplicate idempotency key returns the original receipt
failed validation leaves the source unchanged

gate.safe_default: Temporary repositories and dry-run proposals only. No named real roadmap write.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if temporary-repository tests prove atomic apply, readback, conflict refusal, duplicate suppression and full restoration while every real roadmap write remains gated.
stop_rules: Stop before a real project or docs/plans write without exact PLANNING-WRITE-GO.
Stop if undo cannot restore the exact previous content hash.

slice_queue.objective: Produce a read-only, hash-pinned Agent handoff envelope that cannot start or authorize a run.
evidence_required: mismatched or superseded revision rejected
envelope contains no skill, model, run or command field
no Agent run endpoint called

gate.safe_default: Navigation envelope only; user submission of /abc remains required.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if one exact approved revision and hash produce the declared composer command, launch_authorized is always false and no Planning code can start a run.
stop_rules: Stop if handoff silently resolves a newer revision.
Stop if the UI or route auto-submits /abc.

slice_queue.objective: Port the useful V2 project, graph, list and document-editor interactions into V3 with definition-only semantics.
deliverables: DAG with node-kind and validation styling only
objective, scope, dependencies, deliverables, gate definitions and done-contract detail
draft diff, validation, accept, discard and undo states
Open in Agent composer handoff without start
evidence_required: desktop, mobile and 200 percent zoom screenshots
fixture, live, stale, unavailable, error and conflict states
DOM assertion that every forbidden runtime label and control is absent

gate.safe_default: Use the accepted V3 Calm Control Room system and V2 interaction reference; do not cut over root UI.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if V3 Planning can read and edit definitions and prepare an exact Agent handoff while browser tests prove it renders no execution state, status color, history, heartbeat, claim, evidence receipt or run control.
stop_rules: Stop on an unapproved visual departure from V3 design tokens.
Stop if frontend fixtures can be mistaken for live data.
Stop if runtime truth enters localStorage.

slice_queue.objective: Route definition create, revision, conflict, tombstone and undo notifications to Planning while routing every execution notification to Agent.
deliverables: Planning deep links with project, roadmap and revision
explicit rejection of heartbeat, activity, run failure and run completion targets in Planning
evidence_required: definition event opens the exact Planning revision
execution event target is Agent
undo restores and rereads the prior hash

gate.safe_default: Use fixtures and local route tests only.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if every definition notification resolves one Planning revision and every execution notification is rejected as a Planning target.
stop_rules: Stop if routine reads or draft keystrokes emit notifications.
Stop if a notification contains raw private content.

slice_queue.objective: Prove the Planning/Agent boundary at schema, route and rendered-DOM levels.
deliverables: browser scenarios for empty, loading, live, fixture, stale, error, conflict, edit, handoff and undo
evidence_required: zero unresolved dependencies and zero DAG cycles
zero denylisted fields in Planning API fixtures
zero runtime labels or controls in Planning DOM
exact revision and hash passed to Agent composer

gate.safe_default: Preview only; root UI remains unchanged.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if all contract and browser tests are green, the positive definition-edit path is exercised, the /abc draft is not auto-submitted and every negative runtime-leak assertion is green.
stop_rules: Stop on any runtime leak even if screenshots look correct.
Stop if visual evidence covers only one viewport.

allowed_paths: one operator-named roadmap and its generated undo artifact
slice_queue.objective: Apply and restore one exact real Planning revision with operator-visible readback.
deliverables: restored hash equal to pre-write hash
tests: operator-approved real save smoke for one named roadmap
evidence_required: exact target and diff approval
write receipt
post-write readback
undo receipt
restoration hash equality

gate.safe_default: No real save, tombstone, restore or undo action.

slice_queue.done_when: PASS only if the named revision is applied once, read back, restored once and the final content hash equals the pre-smoke hash; otherwise the slice is failed, not partial.
stop_rules: Stop on any target, hash or diff change after approval.
Stop if rollback evidence is missing.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Accept the definition-only Planning surface at desktop, mobile and 200 percent zoom using the existing V3 Calm Control Room system.
gate_queue.safe_default: Preview implementation may remain fixture-labeled; no root cutover.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Planning could visually reintroduce runtime semantics or become unreadable at non-default viewports.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Name one exact roadmap, base revision, base hash, approved diff, undo target and observation window.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: A real Planning definition could be overwritten or deleted without a reversible operator decision.

non_goals: No run monitor, runtime overlay or control in Planning.
No concrete skill or model picker in Planning.
No direct Temporal client in Planning.
No auto-submit of the /abc composer draft.
No runtime state in canonical Planning JSON or localStorage.
No V2 fixture status or progress semantics copied into V3.
No automatic mass rewrite of legacy roadmaps.
No root UI cutover or real Planning write from repo-only slices.
global_stop_rules: Stop on secrets, raw private content, raw provider output or absolute private paths in fixtures or logs.
Stop on a missing or cyclic dependency.
Stop on overlapping shared hotfiles without acknowledged handoff.
Stop if Planning reads mutable execution state from Agent, Temporal, localStorage or chat memory.
Stop before real write, delete, restore or root cutover without the exact matching gate.
recommended_next_step: Release PDE-01 with focused evidence, then claim PDE-02 service and route-test paths. Treat app.py as a separate serial hotfile sub-claim and stop on any overlapping foreign hunk.
